views.caption: Battery cover hidden. Rigid cage carries tie tension; do not compress the pouch cell. Cell is shown by manufacturer body geometry; tie/wire routing omitted.

views.title: Speaker flange spacer and mounts
views.caption: Rear layer hidden; housing removed above Z8 to expose flange supports and spacer. Local flange bearing Z 1.0–2.7 mm; post top global Z 7.4 mm; rigid spacer 4 mm. No acoustic seal validated.
